_comment: Market season win totals, used ONLY as the preseason prior. Once real games are played the ridge solve takes over and these fade out on the schedule set by ratings.prior_season_weight / early_season_shrink. Refresh them in August each year; they are the single best public estimate of team strength before anyone has played.
_source: 2026 consensus season win totals, cross-checked against the schedule-release board (Yahoo Sports, May 2026). The workbook this project replaced had 11 of these 32 numbers wrong -- NE, CIN, CLE, PIT, JAX, LAC, GB, ATL, NO, ARI and SF -- which pushed every rating derived from them off by 1.6 points.
_scale_note: points_per_win converts a win total into a power rating: (win_total - 8.5) * points_per_win. 1.6 was the workbook's figure and it is about right -- an NFL win is worth roughly 1.5-1.7 points of team strength.
